title: DoD obligates $142B from reconciliation bill before deadline, leaving billions subject to cuts
summary: Any funding from last year’s reconciliation bill left unspent by the Pentagon suffers an 8.3 percent cut known as sequestration as fiscal 2027 starts.
author: Valerie Insinna and Ashley Roque
